phases.goal: Identify the named cans and the plasticbox from the current episode language and view.
phases.name: bind_can_and_box_roles
phases.verify: Both cans and the target box remain visible or reliably localized.

phases.goal: Use exact-prompt VLA chunks to handle contact-rich grasping and placement into the box.
phases.name: continuous_vla_container_place
phases.verify: After the first chunk, decide from observation whether containment is complete or a continuation is needed.

phases.goal: Stop as soon as both cans are inside the plasticbox and released.
phases.name: terminal_containment_check
phases.verify: Both cans are supported by the box and both grippers are clear.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: The phases are transferable guidance; the companion JSONL is one exact historical successful command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize from current observations; never replay clean coordinates from the companion trace.

strategy_notes.language_policy: Stored task_language is the historical clean source language. In new evaluation, the current episode task_language is authoritative; every new lingbot_act must use that complete current language rather than the clean prompt saved in JSONL.

task_language: Move the red can with white Coca-Cola logo and the beverage can with red green graphics one at a time into the boxy light blue plasticbox.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the current episode complete task_language; the stored clean prompt in the companion JSONL is historical evidence only. Relocalize from current observations and do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Protect any can already contained in the box before recovering the other can.
If both cans are held after the first VLA chunk, prefer short exact-prompt continuation over blind analytic transport.
